business: PoriFyx Widget: AI chat receptionist that answers questions and books appointments inside the website chat
by_segment: Clinic or practice (dental, physio, GP, aesthetics)
Small agency that builds sites for these businesses
why_not: I already pay for Fresha and I will not switch my calendar for a chatbot. A bot that guesses at my prices or treatments and books the wrong thing puts my reputation at risk, and I would have to clean up after it.

The thought of an AI giving a customer the wrong price or treatment information worries me, and I'd end up checking every answer myself. My front desk already picks up the phone, and the website is an afterthought, so I don't see the need yet.
My customers phone us and the front desk already handles calls. I can't see why I'd pay $19 or $49 a month for a chat box that the website is only an afterthought for.
I already pay for a booking tool and I'm not switching calendars. Customers would rather phone us, and a chat box that books into Google or Outlook sounds like a second calendar I'd have to babysit.

My booking system already has an online booking button and clients use it. I can't see what a chat receptionist would add that justifies another monthly charge when I'm already counting every subscription.

My booking system already has an online booking button and my web person already set up the contact page. I'd have to think about why I'd pay for a chatbot on top of that, and I don't see the gap yet.

I run plumbing and cleaning jobs all week and I already have a web person who handles the site. Another tool to set up and train, even if it is 15 minutes, is one more thing I will not get round to, and the free plan does not change that.
why_yes: After-hours enquiries are leaking out of my practice and my booking button only works when someone is awake to click it. If this books people at 10pm from my site without me touching the phone, the $19 pays for itself with one extra appointment, so I would start on Starter after the trial.
I lose after-hours enquiries to competitors and my site chat goes unanswered at night. If it books into my calendar and only costs $49 a month, that is cheaper than one missed booking.
flip: Proof from a clinic like mine that the chat books appointments my front desk would otherwise miss.
Seeing it run on my own site with real questions, showing it hands over to my staff instead of guessing, and proof it works alongside Fresha without double bookings.
A free trial that shows, on my own bookings, that it brings in clients my current booking button misses.
It writes straight into the booking tool I already use, so there is no double entry and no second calendar to check.
My web person recommends it and it plugs into the booking system I already pay for, showing me real chats where it booked someone and handed off the rest.
Seeing it answer real questions from my own price list correctly during the free trial, and hand the tricky ones to my staff.
Proof from a business like mine, on a real booking calendar, that it answers correctly and that customers actually use it.
Reviews or a recommendation from a clinic like mine, plus a few weeks on the free plan showing bookings land correctly in my calendar.
Proof from my own site that chat visitors are booking appointments I'd otherwise lose, shown during a free trial before any card is asked for.
Seeing it answer about 20 real questions from a client's own site accurately, with no invented answers, during the free trial.
A written confirmation that it books directly into Fresha, Cliniko and Jobber, plus a setup done for me in under an hour, so I can try the free plan without touching my calendar.
My web person recommends it, or a clinic like mine has run it for a few months and tells me the bookings are real and the chat doesn't embarrass them.
My web person sets it up for me, it is tested on my real price list, and it books straight into my calendar without me touching anything.
Proof it books directly into my existing booking system and brings in bookings I'd otherwise lose after hours, measured on my own site for a couple of weeks.
Proof it books straight into my calendar and hands over to my staff when unsure, shown on a free trial with real visitors using it.
It syncs straight into the Fresha or Cliniko calendar I already run, with a free trial that proves it books real appointments.
If it showed me, with real chats, that it books jobs my phone and existing booking button miss, and it plugged into my current booking system instead of running alongside it.

A written GDPR data processing agreement, clear storage location, and a statement that our chat data is not used to train models, plus proof the calendar booking does not expose other clients' details.
